title: #77 Ryan Floyd on A Time of Gifts

reader_summary.headline: Hello everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by Radei.
reader_summary.overview: Hello everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by Radei. I'm your host, Eddie Palmingen, and this time I'm just back in the studio in Sweden from a couple of weeks traveling around Europe. Fittingly enough, this episode will be about an adventurous journey in Europe that took place almost a hundred years ago.

key_points.text: In this podcast, we like to learn from multiple disciplines how to think, live and invest better.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this podcast, we like to learn from multiple disciplines how to think, live and invest better.

key_points.text: A great way to do this is to talk to bright investors about books that has helped them.
key_points.evidence_quote: A great way to do this is to talk to bright investors about books that has helped them.

key_points.text: And so far, these have often not been the typical investing books, and that is also the case this time.

key_points.text: Today, we look forward to have Ryan Floyd on the show.

thesis: The episode discusses the book 'A Time of Gifts' by Patrick Leigh Fermor, which details his 1933-1934 journey on foot from the Hook of Holland to Constantinople. The speakers highlight that the book is not an investing text but rather a narrative about an 18-year-old traveling overland, interacting with aristocratic families during the rise of fascism, and following his own truth despite traditional expectations.
